description: Count/segment/filter a single event over a date range. e.g. 'Signed up' by country last week. Params `on`/`where` use Mixpanel segmentation expressions like properties["$country_code"]. Query API: GET /segmentation. (Upstream maintenance mode — for saved reports prefer mixpanel_query_insights.)

event.description: Single event name to analyze (not an array).

limit.description: Top N property values (only if `on` set). Default 60.

on.description: Property expression to segment on, e.g. properties["$city"].

name: mixpanel_segmentation
title: Segment an event
